title: Multimodal Medical Image Parsing with Task-Specific Low-Rank Adapters
abstract: arXiv:2610.19901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting a single vision-language model to medical image parsing requires training choices that reflect the demands of each task. We study task-specific adaptation with Qwen3.5-9B for FLARE 2026 Task 3, covering six task families and seven imaging modalities. Our system couples a shared, frozen 4-bit backbone with LoRA adapters selected from the input question. We customize adapter ranks and prompts, rebalance rare classification targets, and supplement regression training with dermatology classification examples. On the fixed internal holdout, the task-specific adapters achieve a dataset-macro balanced accuracy of 0.7791 for classification, a dataset-macro micro-F1 of 0.6286 for multi-label classification, a counting mean absolute error (MAE) of 11.73, a dataset-macro detection F1 of 0.8914, a dataset-macro regression MAE of 9.78, and a report-generation CRIMSON score of 0.8204. translated_title: 基于任务特定低秩适配器的多模态医学图像解析
translated_abstract: 将单一的视觉-语言模型适配到医学图像解析任务，需要能够反映每个任务需求的训练选择。我们针对 FLARE 2026 任务 3 研究了基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的任务特定适配方法，涵盖六个任务族和七种成像模态。我们的系统将一个共享的、冻结的 4-bit 量化主干网络与根据输入问题选择的 LoRA 适配器相结合。我们定制了适配器秩与提示词，重新平衡了稀有分类目标，并利用皮肤病学分类样本补充回归训练。在固定的内部保留集上，任务特定适配器在分类任务上取得了数据集宏平均平衡准确率 0.7791，多标签分类的数据集宏平均 micro-F1 为 0.6286，计数任务的平均绝对误差（MAE）为 11.73，检测任务的数据集宏平均 F1 为 0.8914，回归任务的数据集宏平均 MAE 为 9.78，报告生成的 CRIMSON 分数为 0.8204。在主办方包含 1,703 个样本的隐藏验证集上，
tldr: 该论文提出在冻结的 4-bit 量化 Qwen3.5-9B 主干上，根据输入问题动态选择并定制 LoRA 适配器的秩与提示词，同时结合稀有类别重平衡与数据补充策略，使单一视觉-语言模型能够高效应对覆盖六类任务族和七种成像模态的医学图像解析挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes dynamically selected, task-specific LoRA adapters with customized ranks and prompts on a frozen 4-bit quantized Qwen3.5-9B backbone, enabling a single vision-language model to handle six medical image parsing task families across seven imaging modalities with strong performance.
